titel: De Bresser-vrachtwagen in het groen, voor de footer
plek: De footer van elke pagina. Desktop: een brede band over de hele breedte (ongeveer 1440x322, 4,5:1, uit het midden gesneden) onder een navy laag, met de tekst over de linkerhelft. Telefoon (tot 700 px): een band van 1,9:1 boven de tekst, zonder tekst erover. Bron liggend 21:9, 4K.
lead: Vijf versies van dezelfde wagen, elk in een andere groene omgeving en ander licht: een bomenlaan, een bosrand bij Oisterwijk, het eigen terrein tussen de weilanden, een groen bedrijvenpark en een dijk met knotwilgen. De wagen staat telkens in de rechterhelft en in het midden van de hoogte, zodat hij ook in de smalle band op de computer heel blijft; links is het rustig donkergroen, daar komt de tekst. Er staan geen mensen op. De wagen heeft nog geen belettering: die komt er pas op bij de versie die je kiest, met dezelfde logobestanden als de goedgekeurde wagens 2 en 3. Beoordeel dus de wagen, de omgeving en het licht, niet de letters.

versies.scene: A long straight avenue of very tall old beech and oak trees in Brabant, seen from beside it: the camera stands in a green meadow next to the avenue and looks across the meadow at the road, which runs across the picture behind a row of huge grey trunks, the leafy crowns towering high above. The truck drives along that road toward the left, in the right half of the picture, seen from the side at a slight angle from the front, its cab pointing to the left. The truck is dwarfed by the old trees: the trunks rise far above its roof and the crowns fill the top of the picture. It passes a wide gap between two trunks, so that no trunk stands in front of it. The bottom third of the picture is the meadow in the foreground, long fresh grass. The whole left half of the picture shows trunks and dense dark-green leafy crowns of the avenue in their own shade. Early morning sun low from the right falls through the leaves in soft patches of light on the road and on the side of the box; the air is clear.

versies.scene: A quiet asphalt road runs along the edge of the woods near Oisterwijk. The truck stands parked at the side of the road in the right half of the picture, its rear doors well away from the right edge. Behind it, and filling the whole left half of the picture, a dense wall of mixed forest in full leaf: tall Scots pines with orange-brown upper trunks, oaks and silver birches, a band of ferns and tall grass at the foot of the trees, the shade between the trunks deep green. The camera stands back on the opposite verge, so the bottom third of the picture is a broad strip of grass and ferns in the foreground and the near half of the road. Seen almost side-on with a slight angle from the front. Bright soft light under thin high cloud, the sun as a gentle glow from the upper right, soft shadows under the truck.

versies.scene: Flat green Brabant countryside. In the right half of the picture the truck stands on a short brick-paved yard in front of the company depot, a long low dark grey corrugated steel warehouse without any sign on it, half hidden behind tall full-leaf oaks. The whole left half of the picture is a dense row of tall oaks and lime trees along the plot with a thick hawthorn hedge beneath them, all in their own shade, above a strip of meadow. In the foreground a broad meadow of fresh green grass with a straight ditch. Seen from standing height in the meadow, with a 50mm lens, the truck at a slight angle from the front. Clear midday sun from the right, a blue sky with a few small white clouds only above the depot on the right.

versies.scene: A green, park-like business park. The camera stands on a wide mown lawn some distance from the access road, so the bottom third of the picture is lawn in the foreground. The truck comes along the gently curving road toward the camera at a slight angle, in the right half of the picture, its cab on the left end of the truck and the whole left side of its box in view; near the road on the right, a pond with reeds and groups of young lime trees. The whole left half of the picture, from the top down, is filled by the crown of a large spreading lime tree close to the camera, with its trunk and a clipped beech hedge in its shade; no sky and no building shows in the left half. Low brick office buildings stand only far behind the truck, mostly hidden by young trees and out of focus. Late-afternoon sun from the right, warm but not orange, long soft shadows of the trees across the grass and the road.

versies.scene: The river landscape of Brabant near the Maas. The truck drives along a narrow asphalt road on top of a green grass dike in the right half of the picture, seen from lower down in the polder, from the grass beside a ditch, with a 70mm lens, at a slight angle from the front. The whole left half of the picture is filled by a dense group of old pollard willows and tall elder shrubs at the foot of the dike, close to the camera, their round leafy heads dark green against each other. In front of the right half only a few short pollard willows stand along the ditch, their heads well below the road on the dike, so they never cover the truck. On the dike behind the road stand a few tall poplars in full leaf, spaced well apart and none of them in front of the truck. Bright sun from the right in a blue sky with large white cumulus clouds above the truck, the grass of the dike slope fresh and green.
